notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1] Improvements for some languages:[/h1] 
- English (Credits: Mevious) 
- German (Credits: Gwenhywar) 

[h1] Changes:[/h1] 
- Room list now show games that are in progress.
- Validate minimum time increase from 20s to 30s
- Validate extra time per words increase 0.5s
- Now reports when a player leave the game.

[h1] Bug Fix:[/h1] 
- A bug when the punishment was not applied correctly.
- Other minor fixes.

tags.feature: - Room list now show games that are in progress.

- Validate extra time per words increase 0.5s
